title: Fix regex failure on version strings with leading 'v'
instruction: The parseVersion function fails to parse versions with an optional leading 'v' (e.g. 'v1.2.3'). Modify the regex in parseVersion to support optional leading 'v' while preserving prerelease and build capture groups.

title: Fix numeric identifier comparison inversion in prereleases
instruction: In compareIdentifiers, numeric prerelease identifiers (like '10' vs '2') are being compared lexicographically instead of numerically. Fix compareIdentifiers so numeric parts are compared as integers.

title: Fix strict gt() returning true for equal versions
bug_find: export function gt(v1, v2) { const c = compareVersions(v1, v2); return c !== null && c > 0; }
bug_replace: export function gt(v1, v2) { const c = compareVersions(v1, v2); return c !== null && c >= 0; }
instruction: The gt() function in src/comparator.js is returning true when v1 and v2 are equal. Fix gt() to return strictly true only when compareVersions(v1, v2) > 0.

title: Fix isValid returning true on null/undefined input
instruction: isValid in src/parser.js must validate if a string is a valid semver. Fix isValid to return true only if parseVersion(versionStr) !== null.

title: Fix prerelease precedence inversion breaking range satisfaction
bug_find:
if (preA.length === 0 && preB.length > 0) return 1; // normal > prerelease
  if (preA.length > 0 && preB.length === 0) return -1;
bug_replace:
if (preA.length === 0 && preB.length > 0) return -1;
  if (preA.length > 0 && preB.length === 0) return 1;
instruction: A normal version (no prerelease) should have higher precedence than a prerelease version (e.g. 1.0.0 > 1.0.0-alpha). Fix comparePrereleases in src/comparator.js.

title: Fix caret upper bound inclusivity overflow breaking maxSatisfying
instruction: In parseRange (src/ranges.js), caret ranges for major > 0 (like ^1.2.3) are using '<=' for the upper bound instead of strict '<', allowing 2.0.0 to satisfy ^1.2.3. Fix upper bound operator to '<'.

title: Fix antisymmetry violation in version comparator
instruction: compareVersions in src/comparator.js has inverted major version comparison logic. Fix it so that when p1.major > p2.major it returns 1, and -1 when p1.major < p2.major.

title: Fix zero-major caret ranges not constraining minor boundary at 0.3.0
instruction: For zero-major versions with non-zero minor (e.g. ^0.2.3), the upper bound must be `< 0.3.0` (0.${base.minor + 1}.0), not `< 1.0.0`. Fix the upper bound in parseRange (src/ranges.js).

title: Fix prerelease version incorrectly satisfying normal caret range
instruction: In satisfiesRange (src/ranges.js), a prerelease version (e.g. 1.0.0-beta.1) should not satisfy a normal range like ^1.0.0 unless the range explicitly targets the same tuple. Enforce prerelease isolation in satisfiesRange.

title: Fix minSatisfying selecting maximum version instead of minimum
instruction: minSatisfying in src/satisfier.js is using gt(v, min) which finds the maximum version instead of lt(v, min). Fix minSatisfying to find the minimum satisfying version using lt(v, min).
